sentence: This project tries to find out how the epigenome changes as pancreatic cancer develops and spreads, using mouse models and human tissues.
This project tests magnetic resonance imaging methods on knee specimens and builds a tool that automatically outlines and measures all major knee joint tissues.
This project tests whether auditory stimulation during sleep can help memory in schizophrenia, and builds a measure of memory consolidation in the hippocampus.
This project tries to find out which cell populations repopulate the intestine after severe radiation injury, using a model system.
This project studies the structure and molecules of the centriolar plaque in an alveolate protist, using expansion microscopy, to understand cell division.
This project studies the ecology and genetics of insecticide resistance in African malaria vectors.
This project builds targeted nanoparticles that deliver gene therapy to hematopoietic stem cells inside the body to treat primary immunodeficiencies.
This project tests whether editing high-risk genetic variants into low-risk forms in human ocular cells can prevent or delay age-related macular degeneration.
This project uses transcriptomic methods on baboon and human peritoneal lesions to find inflammatory pathways in early endometriosis lesions.
This project provides sequencing and genomics technologies, including long-read sequencing and microarrays, for cancer researchers.
This project tests whether engineered stem cells can deliver gene editing cargo in an animal model of Huntington's disease.
This project supports studies of adipose tissue, muscle, liver and endothelium in obesity, including cell culture and extracellular vesicles.
This project builds virus-like particles that carry RNA across the blood-brain barrier to the brain, and sets up screening platforms to improve them.
This project develops a non-viral gene editing therapy in lipid nanoparticles that targets the trabecular meshwork to treat primary open-angle glaucoma.
This project studies how the metabolite itaconate acts on a lysosomal reductase to help macrophages defend against infection.
This project uses genomics and other specialized evaluation to diagnose rare disorders in undiagnosed patients.
This project builds a DNA-based molecular robot that detects breast cancer microRNAs and regulates genes that act as therapeutic agents.
This project studies how human papillomaviruses deliver their genome to the nucleus of basal cells and establish infection.
This project builds biologically plausible computational models of behaviors that depend on the medial temporal lobe, using a deep learning framework.
This project tries to find out how different exposures to anti-HIV antibodies help the body control HIV after antiretroviral therapy stops.
